Description du produit 
 TYPE-MOON, connu pour la célèbre appli de jeu « Fate/Grand Order » et pour le roman visuel épique « Tsukihime », publie le roman visuel « Witch on the Holy Night », sorti une première fois en 2012 en version PC, sur Steam.
 Découvrez l’histoire d’un jeune adulte, située dans les années 80 dynamiques et trépidantes, à la suite d’un jeune homme innocent et deux jeunes « sorcières ».
 Les mises à jour ajoutées depuis la version pour PC comportent des personnages entièrement doublés, ce que les fans attendaient depuis longtemps, ainsi que des visuels remastérisés en Full HD, ce qui rend l’expérience vivante grâce à une qualité d’image sans précédent.
 Les divers éléments visuels nouveaux ne se cantonnent pas à saturer de tension les scènes de combat, ils donnent également vie aux activités quotidiennes des personnages avec des mouvements rappelant un film d’animation et ils rendent les dialogues encore plus captivants.
 
  INTRIGUE Deux sorcières résident dans un manoir au sommet d’une colline.
 
 C’est la fin des années 80, années déclinantes d’une époque dynamique et trépidante.
 Un garçon arrive en ville et rencontre deux sorcières vivant à l’époque présente.
 
 Le garçon mène une vie normale.
 Une des filles est fière et digne.
 L’autre vit cachée, comme en léthargie.
 
 Trois étoiles sur une orbite parallèle, condamnées à ne jamais se rencontrer.
 La façon dont ces trois personnages très différents finissent par vivre ensemble sous un même toit sera bientôt révélée...

Produktbeschreibung 
 TYPE-MOON, bekannt für die populäre Game-App „Fate/Grand Order“ und die epische Visual Novel „Tsukihime“, bringen eine weiteres ihrer Werke, „Witch on the Holy Night“, das 2012 erstmals auf dem PC erschienen ist, nun auch auf die Steam.
 Erlebe eine Young-Adult-Story um einen unschuldigen jungen Mann und zwei junge „Hexen“ in den pulsierenden, aufregenden 1980er Jahren.
 Seit der PC-Veröffentlichung haben die Charaktere eine volle Sprachausgabe bekommen, auf die Fans lange gewartet haben, und die Grafik wurde in Full-HD remastered, um die Geschichte mit unvergleichlicher Bildqualität zum Leben zu erwecken.
 Die zahlreichen neuen visuellen Elemente verleihen nicht nur den Kampfszenen mehr Spannung, sondern hauchen auch dem Alltag der Charaktere neues Leben ein, mit Bewegungen, die den Bildern ein Feeling von Animationsfilmen geben und dich noch tiefer in den Text eintauchen lassen.
 
  STORY 
 In einem Herrenhaus auf einem Hügel leben zwei Hexen.
 
 Es sind die späten 1980er Jahre, eine pulsierende, aufregende Ära neigt sich dem Ende zu.
 Ein junger Mann kommt in die Stadt und findet heraus, dass hier zwei Hexen in der Moderne leben.
 
 Der junge Mann führt eigentlich ein ganz normales Leben.
 Eines der Mädchen ist stolz und anmutig.
 Das andere lebt zurückgezogen, fast wie im Dornröschenschlaf.
 
 Drei Sterne auf ihren eigenen Umlaufbahnen, in ihren eigenen Welten.
 Die Geschichte, wie diese drei so unterschiedlichen Charaktere sich eines Tages unter einem Dach wiederfinden, diese Story wird bald erzählt werden...

Product Description 
 TYPE-MOON, known for the wildly popular mobile game "Fate/Grand Order" and the epic visual novel "Tsukihime," is releasing a remaster of the 2012 hit "Witch on the Holy Night. Experience a coming of age story set in the vibrant, bustling 1980s, which follows an innocent young man and two young "witches." Updates added since the original release include long-awaited fully voiced characters as well as visuals remastered in full HD, bringing the experience to life with unparalleled quality and fidelity. Masterful manipulation of visual elements imbues combat scenes with nail-biting tension, but also breathes life into the characters' everyday activities. Animated graphical elements bring an entirely new level of depth to the reading experience as well!
 
  STORY 
 In the mansion on the hill, there lived two witches...
 
 It is the late 1980s—the twilight of an era of beauty and vigor.
 A boy moves to the city, barely missing two witches living in modern times.
 
 The boy leads a completely ordinary life.
 She carries herself with gallant pride.
 The girl lives a sleepy, hidden life.
 
 Each walks a starlit path.
 One would never expect their paths to cross.
 The story of how these three disparate people came together is soon to be told.

Produktbeskrivelse 
 TYPE-MOON, kendt for den populære spil-app ”Fate/Grand Order” og den episke visuelle roman ”Tsukihime”, udgiver den visuelle roman ”Witch on the Holy Night”, der første gang blev lanceret til pc i 2012, på Steam.
 Oplev en ung voksenfortælling, der foregår i de livlige og travle 1980ʼere, som følger en uskyldig ung mand og to unge ”hekse”.
 Opdateringer tilføjet siden pc-versionen omfatter både stemmer til alle personer, hvilket fans har ventet længe på, og forbedrede visuelle effekter i fuld HD, der vækker oplevelsen til live med uovertruffen billedkvalitet.
 Forskellige nye visuelle elementer præger ikke alene kampscenerne med spænding, men puster også liv i personernes hverdagsaktiviteter med bevægelser, der giver en følelse af animation og gør teksten endnu mere dybt opslugende.
 
  HANDLING 
 To hekse opholder sig på en herregård på toppen af en bakke.
 
 Det er sidst i 1980ʼerne, tusmørkeårene i en livlig og travl æra.
 En dreng kommer til byen kun for at støde på to hekse, der lever i dag.
 
 Drengen lever et normalt liv.
 En af pigerne er stolt og værdig.
 Den anden lever i skjul som var hun i dvale.
 
 Tre stjerner i parallelt kredsløb med den skæbne aldrig at mødes.
 Historien om, hvordan disse tre helt forskellige personer kommer til at leve under samme tag, afsløres snart...

Descrizione prodotto 
 TYPE-MOON, conosciuto per la popolare app di gioco “Fate/Grand Order” e l’epica visual novel “Tsukihime”, sta per rilasciare la visual novel “Witch on the Holy Night”, pubblicata per la prima volta per PC nel 2012, sulla Steam.
 La storia, ambientata nei dinamici e stimolanti anni 80, è quella di giovani adulti e racconta di un ragazzo innocente e di due giovani “streghe”.
 Gli aggiornamenti rispetto alla versione per PC comprendono i personaggi a tutto tondo che i fan hanno atteso da molto tempo, nonché una grafica rimasterizzata in full HD, che anima l’esperienza con una qualità dell’immagine impareggiabile.
 I nuovi e svariati elementi visivi non soltanto arricchiscono di tensione le scene di battaglia, ma infondono anche vita alle attività quotidiane dei personaggi, con movimenti che apportano un senso di animazione e rendono il testo ancora più profondamente coinvolgente.
 
  STORIA 
 Due streghe abitano in una dimora sulla cima di una collina.
 
 Sono gli ultimi anni 80, gli anni del crepuscolo di un'epoca dinamica e stimolante.
 Un ragazzo arriva in città e finisce per incontrare due streghe che vivono nei tempi attuali.
 
 Il ragazzo conduce una vita normale.
 Una delle ragazze è orgogliosa e ricca di dignità.
 L’altra vive nascosta, come se immersa nel torpore.
 
 Tre stelle che si trovano su orbite parallele, destinate a non incontrarsi mai.
 La storia di come questi tre personaggi completamente diversi arrivano a vivere sotto lo stesso tetto sarà presto rivelata...

Set in 1980s Japan, Witch on the Holy Night tells the story of fan-favorite Type-Moon character Aoko Aozaki as she attempts to navigate the complex world of magecraft while also dealing with the everyday struggles of life as a high school student! Players will experience the thrilling origin story of this much-beloved character, penned by Kinoko Nasu, famed creator of the Fate series, himself.

---Two witches live in a mansion on a hill---

The late 1980s. The twilight of an era full of splendor and vitality.
A young boy comes down to the city and crosses paths with two witches living in the modern age.

The boy has lived a very natural life.
She lives a dignified life with her breasts outstretched.
The girl lives in hiding as if she were asleep.

The three of them are three different star-crossed people.
They are not supposed to cross each other.
The three of them are different in every way, and their shared life together will not begin until a little while later...

■作品概要 
 曾带来游戏App《Fate/Grand Order》和长篇奇幻视觉小说《月姬》的「TYPE-MOON」
 于2012年发售的视觉小说《魔法使之夜》将于Steam登场。
 本作是以繁华且活力四射的1980年代为舞台，
 由未经世事的少年与被称为“魔女”的两位少女交织而成的青年向小说。
 相较于PC原版，登陆Steam平台的本作，不仅实现了粉丝期待已久的全语音化，
 还对画面与影像素材进行了全高清HD化升级，呈现出更加丰富多彩的视觉效果。
 本作中巧用各类图像素材，展现出紧张感十足的战斗场景。
 同时日常生活的场景也不在话下，各类场景富有动感栩栩如生，仿佛是一部精美的动画巨作。
 进一步加深玩家在本作中的沉浸体验。
 
  ■STORY 
 ―――在那坡道尽头的古宅之中，有两位魔女闲居于此―――
 
 时值1980年代后期，这个繁华又充满活力的时代正值黄昏。
 来到城市的少年，与生活在现代社会的两位魔女萍水相逢。
 
 少年的日常起居与一般人别无二致，
 而她总是昂首挺胸盛气凛然，
 少女则是仿佛熟睡一般隐居于此。
 形色各异的三人相逢于此，
 他们的命运就此开始交织。
 截然不同的三人，他们共同生活的故事即将开幕——―

■作品簡介 
 操刀過知名遊戲《Fate/Grand Order》以及長篇傳奇視覺小說《月姬》的「TYPE-MOON」，
 為您將2012年發行的視覺小說《魔法使之夜》，呈現在Steam的平台。
 本作品是一部以華麗且充滿活力的1980年代為舞台，
 由一位涉世未深的少年及兩名被稱為「魔女」的少女所共同編織出的青春物語。
 依據PC版的內容加以更新，除加上了所有粉絲引頸期盼的全語音，
 遊戲中的所有圖片以及影像素材皆經Full HD處理，呈現出其他遊戲無法比擬的精彩畫面。
 遊戲內的演出巧妙地活用各種圖像素材，不僅是緊張刺激的戰鬥場面，
 就連日常生活場景也發揮其效，經常能看見猶如動畫般的動作，
 讓玩家們更容易沉浸於文字的世界中。
 
  ■STORY 
 ―――坡道上的宅邸裡，住著兩位魔女―――
 
 1980年後半。這充滿活力且紙醉金迷的時代，某個黃昏時分。
 一位來到大都會的少年，與兩位活在現代的魔女擦肩而過。
 
 少年原在極度自然的環境下生活，
 其中一位少女性格驕傲凜然，
 另一位則如沉眠般的隱居著。
 原本三人的命運理應毫無交集，
 會兜在一起實屬離奇。
 而為何這三個原本毫無交集的人會開始同居生活呢？這又是另外一個故事了―――

■作品概要 
 ゲームアプリ『Fate/Grand Order』、長編伝奇ビジュアルノベル『月姫』を手がける
 「TYPE-MOON」が、2012年に発売したビジュアルノベル
 『魔法使いの夜』をSteam向けに送り出す。
 本作は、華やかさと活力に満ちた1980年代を舞台として、
 世間知らずの少年と"魔女"と称される2人の少女とが織りなす
 ジュブナイルストーリーとなっている。
 PC版からのアップデート内容として、ファン待望のフルボイス化に加えて、
 画像や映像素材のフルHD化を行うことで、他に類を見ない豊かな映像を実現。
 各種画像素材を巧みに使用した演出が、緊張感のあるバトルシーンはもちろん、
 日常のシーンにも生かされており、時にアニメーションを思わせる動きは、
 ユーザーのテキストへの没入感をさらに深めている。
 
  ■STORY 
 ―――坂の上のお屋敷には、二人の魔女が住んでいる―――
 
 1980年代後半。華やかさと活力に満ちた時代の黄昏時。
 都会におりてきた少年は、現代に生きる二人の魔女とすれ違う。
 
 少年はごく自然に暮らしてきて、
 彼女は凛々しく胸を張って、
 少女は眠るように隠れ住んで。
 
 三者三様の星の巡り。
 交わることなんてもってのほか。
 何もかも違う三人の共同生活が始まるのは、あと、もうちょっと先の話―――

game.title: Volcano Princess
game.description:
After the war between humans and demons, you found a baby on the battlefield and became a father. You will Plan time and courses for her, bring her into contact with various roles, and raise her up. The daughter's future and the ending of the volcano country depends on each of your choices.

Spend precious time with your daughter as she grows up!
You were a soldier of great virtue, who found this little girl the night the war ended.Raise your daughter from infancy, through schooling and into adulthood as you accompany her on the path to adulthood.

When you take your daughter out, as well as boating, eating, and amusement, you can also meet all kinds of town residents.
These residents aren't simply passengers in your daughter's life journey, they also have their own lives!
NPC residents have their own stories, and the choices of you and your daughter will affect their lives.
A wholesome and tender bonding experience!
Start with babbling and crawling, slowly learn manners, etiquette, knowledge...carefully arrange everything for her.Let her learn music and painting, or make her proficient in martial arts and fighting. What kind of future will intertwine with dozens of different skill combinations?

If you neglect her, your daughter may go astray.
Volcano Festival celebration! Competition! Adventure!
In the grand Volcano Festival celebration, let your daughter show off her skills in the competition!The secrets of the ancestors lay buried in the dark canyon, waiting for the brave to discover…
A variety of endings!
What kind of person will the daughter become?Will she be outstanding, ordinary, or evil?
Every decision will affect your daughter's future.
She can become anything and pursue all kinds of dreams, everything is up to you.

game.title: Project Zomboid
game.description:
Project Zomboid is the ultimate in zombie survival. Alone or in MP: you loot, build, craft, fight, farm and fish in a struggle to survive. A hardcore RPG skillset, a vast map, a massively customisable sandbox and a cute tutorial raccoon await the unwary. So how will you die?

The Knox Event is used to refer to the zombie outbreak that occurs prior to and throughout the game. The event first takes place around Muldraugh and West Point, Kentucky. The incident is considered to have begun on the 4th of July, 1993, American Day of Independence. Just two days later the military evacuated residences from around the affected area and set up blockades in what is now known as the Knox Evacuation. The affected area is given the name: the Exclusion Zone, with the primary camp being south of Louisville.

開放世界生存恐怖電子遊戲
开放世界生存恐怖电子游戏

Project Zomboid is an open-ended zombie-infested sandbox. It asks one simple question – how will you die? 
 
 In the towns of Muldraugh and West Point, survivors must loot houses, build defences and do their utmost to delay their inevitable death day by day. No help is coming – their continued survival relies on their own cunning, luck and ability to evade a relentless horde. Current Features 
   Hardcore Sandbox Zombie Survival Game with a focus on realistic survival.
   Online multiplayer survival with persistent player run servers. 
   Local 4 player split-screen co-op
   Hundreds of zombies with swarm mechanics and in-depth visual and hearing systems. 
   Full line of sight system and real-time lighting, sound and visibility mechanics. Hide in the shadows, keep quiet and keep the lights off at night, or at least hang sheets over the windows.   
   Vast and growing map (loosely based on a real world location) for you to explore, loot and set up your fortress. Check out Blindcoder’s map project: 
    Vehicles with full physics and deep and realistic gameplay mechanics.
   Use tools and items to craft weapons, barricade and cook. You can even build zombie proof forts by chopping trees, sawing wood and scavenging supplies. 
   Deal with depression, boredom, hunger, thirst and illness while trying to survive. 
   Day turns to night. The electricity falters. Hordes migrate. Winter draws in. Nature gradually starts to take over.
   Farming, fishing, carpentry, cooking, trapping, character customization, skills and perks that develop based on what you do in-game. 
   Proper zombies that don’t run. (Unless you tell them to in the sandbox menu).
   A ton of amazing atmospheric music tracks by the prodigy that is Zach Beever. 
   Imaginative Challenge scenarios and instant action ‘Last Stand’ mode, on top of regular Sandbox and Survival 
   Full, open and powerful Lua modding support. 
   Xbox Controller Gamepad support on Windows. (Other gamepads can be set up manually.)
 
 We’re a small team at the moment, but we’re also committed to providing the following:    planned Features:    
   The return of our PZ Stories mode that also serves as first ever tutorial actively trying to kill you at every turn. Kate and Baldspot return!
   In-depth and varied NPC encounters driven in a persistent world, powered by a metagame system that turns each play-through into your very own zombie survival movie with emergent narrative gameplay.
   Constant expansion of the countryside and cities around Muldraugh and West Point
   Full wilderness survival systems, animals and hunting for food. 
   More items, crafting recipes, weapons and gameplay systems. 
   Steam Workshop and Achievements support  
 For more details on the game follow us on @theindiestone or visit

Project Zomboid is an open-ended zombie-infested sandbox. It asks one simple question – how will you die? 
  In the towns within the Knox Event Exclusion Zone our survivors must loot houses, build defences and do their utmost to delay their inevitable death day by day. No help is coming. Continued survival relies on cunning, luck, and the ability to evade a relentless horde... 
  
   Current Features     Hardcore Sandbox Zombie Survival Game with a focus on realistic survival.
    Online multiplayer survival with persistent player-run servers.
    Hundreds of zombies with swarm mechanics and in-depth visual and hearing systems.
    Full line of sight system and real-time lighting, sound and visibility mechanics. Get spotted? Fire a gun? You’re in trouble…
    Absolutely vast, and growing, map that’s loosely based on real world Kentucky. A huge area in which you explore, loot and set up your fortress.
    Vehicles with full physics, and deep and realistic gameplay mechanics.
    Tools and items can be used to craft weapons, barricade and cook. Build zombie-proof forts by chopping trees, sawing wood and scavenging supplies.
    Deal with depression, boredom, hunger, thirst and illness while trying to survive.
    Day turns to night. The electricity falters. Hordes migrate. Winter draws in. Nature gradually starts to take over.
    Farming, fishing, carpentry, cooking, trapping, character customisation, skills and perks that develop based on what you do in-game.
    Proper zombies that don’t run. (Unless you tell them to in the sandbox menu).
    Atmospheric dynamic music that matches your Knox Event adventure.
    Imaginative Challenge scenarios, on top of our regular Outbreak, Rising, Apocalypse and nightmarish Extinction modes.
    Local split-screen co-op.
    Full, open and powerful Lua modding support.
    Xbox Controller Gamepad support on Windows. (Other gamepads can be set up manually)
    
   Planned Features     The return of Kate and Baldspot, the initial story-driven stars of the Project Zomboid tech demo. 
    In-depth and varied NPC encounters driven in a persistent world, powered by a metagame system that turns each play-through into your very own zombie survival movie with emergent narrative gameplay.
    Constant expansion/overhaul of the countryside, towns and city that have been ravaged by the Knox Event
    More items, crafting recipes, weapons and gameplay systems.
    Steam Achievements support.

game.brief:
Project Zomboid is the ultimate in zombie survival. Alone or in MP: you loot, build, craft, fight, farm and fish in a struggle to survive. A hardcore RPG skillset, a vast map, a massively customisable sandbox and a cute tutorial raccoon await the unwary. So how will you die?

The Knox Event is used to refer to the zombie outbreak that occurs prior to and throughout the game. The event first takes place around Muldraugh and West Point, Kentucky. The incident is considered to have begun on the 4th of July, 1993, American Day of Independence. Just two days later the military evacuated residences from around the affected area and set up blockades in what is now known as the Knox Evacuation. The affected area is given the name: the Exclusion Zone, with the primary camp being south of Louisville.

game.title: YOU and ME and HER: A Love Story
game.description:
A visual novel that pushes the boundaries of the format in unique and stunning ways, YOU and ME and HER: A Love Story has to be played to be believed. When Shinichi decides to help the class outcast Aoi, he enlists the help of Miyuki, the most popular girl in school. But when romance enters the picture, the triangle becomes unstable and the future becomes uncertain. Gorgeous artwork by Tsuji Santa and full voice acting by the original Japanese VA cast make YOU and ME and HER a love story you’ll never forget. Story 
  Life is like a staircase. You just gotta keep climbing. Otherwise, if you start to overthink it, you'll have trouble taking the next step. 
 
 Shinichi wants nothing more than to lead a quiet life. Though he was once close friends with Miyuki, the most popular girl in school, his desire for normalcy now keeps them from being anything more than classmates.
 
 Everything changes, however, one day on the roof, when the class oddball, Aoi, suddenly tries to kiss him. Miyuki appears just in time to stop her, but afterward, Shinichi feels the urge to bring some light to this friendless girl's eyes. He enlists Miyuki's aid, and thus, a trio is born.
 
 The days pass, and little by little, Aoi learns what it means to be friends. But at the same time, long-dormant feelings awaken in Miyuki's heart. As the distance between her and Shinichi shrinks, the hard-earned bonds the three share begin to fray.
 
 Miyuki or Aoi－when the time comes, which will Shinichi choose? Game Description 
  YOU and ME and HER: A Love Story  is a multi-path visual novel from acclaimed developer Nitro+. It features beautiful artwork, music, and Japanese voice acting with full English text. Direct the story by making decisions at key points in the narrative. The ending is yours to decide.

《君与彼女与彼女之恋》是由Nitro+制作的ADV游戏，于2013年06月28日发售。
每天，仿 佛走台阶一般的度过。
简直像背景一般毫无个性的男主角须须木心一，和学校人气偶像的曾根美雪虽然是青梅竹马，但因为不想引人注目以及成长隔阂的因素，基本上不与她来往，就这样做为普通同学度过平凡的每一天。
一天，心一被好友曙雄太郎叫到了天台上，在那里却碰上了无法融入班级的电波女向日葵。
“要来，哔哩哔哩吗？”葵一面说着，一面向惊慌失措的心一索吻。突然出现的青梅竹马美雪以意想不到的方式（对葵称心一是自己的男朋友），为心一解围，不过葵此后却缠上了心一。
葵没 有朋友，也没有正常人应有的情感，为了挽救这个电波女，心一拜托美雪一起帮助葵如何融入常人的生活。就这样，三人的命运就此联系起来。葵逐渐的摆脱电波，向着正常女生方向发展，美雪对于心一的心意也逐渐显露出来，不断地缩小与心一的隔阂。好不容易成为朋友的三人，逐渐陷入尴尬的境地。
本以为能一直在一起的三人，却再也不能走到一起，心一会选择谁，美雪亦或是葵？
Galgame君与彼女与彼女之恋的剧情就此展开。

You and Me and Her: A Love Story is the visual novel medium in its purest form. Will Shinichi choose Miyuki, the beautiful queen bee of the school, or the endearingly awkward misfit Aoi? With art by Tsuji Santa, these beautifully rendered romances will stay with you forever.

Life is like a staircase. You just gotta keep climbing. Otherwise, if you start to overthink it, you'll have trouble taking the next step.

Shinichi wants nothing more than to lead a quiet life. Though he was once close friends with Miyuki, the most popular girl in school, his desire for normalcy now keeps them from being anything more than classmates.

Everything changes, however, one day on the roof, when the class oddball, Aoi, suddenly tries to kiss him. Miyuki appears just in time to stop her, but afterward, Shinichi feels the urge to bring some light to this friendless girl's eyes. He enlists Miyuki's aid, and thus, a trio is born.

The days pass, and little by little, Aoi learns what it means to be friends. But at the same time, long-dormant feelings awaken in Miyuki's heart. As the distance between her and Shinichi shrinks, the hard-earned bonds the three share begin to fray.

Miyuki or Aoi－when the time comes, which will Shinichi choose?

毎日は、階段のように過ぎていく。
每天，仿佛走台阶一般的度过。


まるでモブのように無個性な主人公・心一。
宛如路人一般缺乏个性的男主角・心一。

学園のヒロイン・美雪とは幼馴染みだが、目立ちたくないがために声をかけることもなく、ただのクラスメイトの1人として、平凡な日々を過ごしていた。
虽然和学园的偶像・美雪是青梅竹马，但因为不想引人注目，也基本和她没有来往，就这样作为普通的同学度过着平凡的每一天。

そんなある日、親友の雄太郎に呼び出され向かった屋上で出会ったのは、クラスで浮いている電波少女・アオイ。
一天，心一被好友雄太郎叫到了屋顶，不过在那里他遇见的、却是无法融入班级的电波少女・向日葵。

「ビリビリ、するの？」そんな言葉とともに、突然キスを迫られた心一。偶然居合わせた美雪に助けられ、なんとかその場は切り抜けたが、それ以後アオイに奇妙につきまとわれるようになる。
“要来，哔哩哔哩么？”向日葵一边这么说着，一边逼近心一要和他接吻。不过凑巧被当时在场的美雪帮了一把才勉强逃掉，不过事后他却依然不断的被向日葵纠缠。

友達もなく、人間らしい感情を持たないアオイ。彼女に友達との付き合い方を教えてやりたくて、意を決して美雪に頼み込み、3人で時間を過ごすことに。
面对既没有朋友，也没有人类应有情感的向日葵。心一想要教会她与人的交流方式，于是下定决心拜托美雪。就这样，三人凑在了一起。

日が経つにつれ、徐々に人間らしい感情に目覚めていくアオイ。一方美雪も、幼い頃無理矢理押さえ込んでいた心一への想いが蘇り、徐々に主人公との距離を詰めていく。せっかく友達同士になれたのに、日に日にギクシャクしていく3人の関係。
随着时间的推移，向日葵也开始逐渐的唤醒了人类应有的情感。另一方面，美雪自幼抑制着的对心一的感情也开始唤醒，不断的缩短和心一的距离。好不容易成为了朋友的三人，关系却变得日渐尴尬起来。


ずっと、一緒にいられると思ってた——
本以为会一直在一起的——

でも、3人ではもう、いられない——
但是已经不能在一起的三人——

主人公が選ぶのは美雪か、それともアオイか……？
心一会选择的，到底会是美雪，还是向日葵……？

game.title: Devil May Cry 5
game.description:
Devil May Cry 5 is a brand-new entry in the legendary over-the-top action series Devil May Cry. The game features three playable characters, each with a radically different stylish combat play style as they take on the city overrun with demons. Developed with Capcom’s in-house proprietary RE engine, the series continues to achieve new heights in fidelity with graphics that utilize photorealistic character designs and stunning lighting and environmental effects.

The game takes place five years after Devil May Cry 4 and follows a trio of warriors with demonic powers, the returning Dante, Nero, and a new protagonist named V, as they attempt to stop the Demon King Urizen from destroying the human world.

game.title: Assassin's Creed Unity
game.description:
A RUTHLESS NEW HERO FOR A BRUTAL NEW WORLD  
Play as Arno, an entirely new breed of Assassin more lethal than his ancestors. Take down your prey with a range of new weapons such as the Phantom Blade, a Hidden Blade with crossbow capabilities.
        
  EXPERIENCE SEAMLESS PARKOUR, COMBAT, AND STEALTH GAMEPLAY  
Enjoy a high degree of freedom and control over your Assassin, with parkour mechanics for seamless free running, a revamped fighting system, and enhanced stealth gameplay.
        
  DISCOVER REVOLUTIONARY PARIS  
The French Revolution turns a once magnificent city into a place of terror and chaos. Explore the stunning, full-scale open world city and witness history unfold. Experience key events, from the storming of the Bastille to the execution of King Louis XVI, as France's fate is shaped in the streets of a city on the edge of transformation.

localized_description.text:
A RUTHLESS NEW HERO FOR A BRUTAL NEW WORLD  
Play as Arno, an entirely new breed of Assassin more lethal than his ancestors. Take down your prey with a range of new weapons such as the Phantom Blade, a Hidden Blade with crossbow capabilities.
        
  EXPERIENCE SEAMLESS PARKOUR, COMBAT, AND STEALTH GAMEPLAY  
Enjoy a high degree of freedom and control over your Assassin, with parkour mechanics for seamless free running, a revamped fighting system, and enhanced stealth gameplay.
        
  DISCOVER REVOLUTIONARY PARIS  
The French Revolution turns a once magnificent city into a place of terror and chaos. Explore the stunning, full-scale open world city and witness history unfold. Experience key events, from the storming of the Bastille to the execution of King Louis XVI, as France's fate is shaped in the streets of a city on the edge of transformation.

UN HÉROE DESPIADADO PARA UN MUNDO BRUTAL  
Ponte en la piel de Arno, una nueva clase de asesino mucho más letal que sus antepasados. Elimina a tu presa con una variedad de armas nuevas, como la Hoja fantasma, una hoja oculta que puede usarse como ballesta.
        
  DISFRUTA DE MECÁNICAS DE PARKOUR, COMBATE Y SIGILO FLUIDAS  
Controla con total libertad a tu asesino con una mecánica de parkour que permite correr libremente con fluidez, un sistema de combate renovado y una mecánica de sigilo mejorada.
        
  DESCUBRE EL PARÍS REVOLUCIONARIO  
La Revolución Francesa ha convertido una ciudad, antaño majestuosa, en un lugar de terror y caos. Explora esta fabulosa ciudad de mundo abierto a escala real y sé testigo de cómo se desarrolla la historia. Vive momentos históricos clave, desde la toma de la Bastilla hasta la ejecución del rey Luis XVI, mientras el destino de Francia se decide en las calles de una ciudad que está experimentando una profunda transformación.

UN NOUVEAU HÉROS SANS PITIÉ POUR UN MONDE SANS MERCI  
Incarnez Arno, un nouveau genre d'Assassins, plus mortel que ses prédécesseurs. Terrassez vos proies avec un arsenal d'armes inédites comme la Lame fantôme, une lame secrète avec une arbalète intégrée.
        
  UN GAMEPLAY FLUIDE MÊLANT PARKOUR, COMBAT ET INFILTRATION  
Profitez d'une grande liberté et d'un contrôle total sur votre Assassin, avec des mécaniques de parkour fluides, un système de combat repensé et un gameplay de furtivité amélioré.
        
  DÉCOUVREZ LE PARIS RÉVOLUTIONNAIRE  
La Révolution française transforme une ville autrefois magnifique en un lieu de terreur et de chaos. Explorez une ville en monde ouvert à échelle 1:1 et regardez l'Histoire se dérouler sous vos yeux. Revivez les événements clés, de la prise de la Bastille à l'exécution du roi Louis XVI, alors que le destin de la France se joue dans les rues d'une ville en pleine transformation.

EIN SKRUPELLOSER NEUER HELD FÜR EINE BRUTALE NEUE WELT  
Spiele als Arno, ein völlig neuer Assassine, der noch tödlicher als seine Vorfahren ist. Erlege deine Beute mit einer Auswahl neuer Waffen wie der Phantomklinge, einer Versteckten Klinge mit eingebauter Armbrust.
        
  ERLEBE NAHTLOSES GAMEPLAY MIT PARKOUR, KAMPF UND SCHLEICHEN  
Genieße ein hohes Maß an Freiheit und Kontrolle über deinen Assassinen, mit Parkour-Mechaniken für nahtloses Free-Running, einem überarbeiteten Kampfsystem und verbessertem Schleichen.
        
  ENTDECKE PARIS WÄHREND DER REVOLUTION  
Die Französische Revolution verwandelt eine einst prachtvolle Stadt in einen Ort des Terrors und der Zerstörung. Erkunde die atemberaubende, originalgetreue Open-World-Stadt und erlebe, wie Geschichte geschrieben wird. Erlebe wichtige historische Ereignisse, vom Sturm auf die Bastille bis zur Hinrichtung von König Ludwig XVI., während das Schicksal Frankreichs auf den Straßen einer sich verwandelnden Stadt seinen Lauf nimmt.

UM NOVO HERÓI IMPLACÁVEL PARA UM NOVO MUNDO BRUTAL  
Jogue como Arno, um tipo de assassino totalmente novo, mais letal que seus antecessores. Cace suas presas com uma gama de novas armas, tais como a Lâmina Fantasma, uma Lâmina Oculta com a capacidade de disparar como uma besta.
        
  EXPERIMENTE A JOGABILIDADE FLUIDA EM PARKOUR, COMBATE E FURTIVIDADE  
Desfrute de um alto grau de liberdade e controle sobre seu assassino, com mecânicas de parkour que possibilitam movimentos livres e fluídos, um sistema de combate reformulado e jogabilidade de furtividade aprimorada.
        
  DESCUBRA A PARIS REVOLUCIONÁRIA  
A Revolução Francesa transformou uma cidade magnífica em um ambiente de terror e caos. Explore essa cidade impressionante como um mundo aberto em larga escala e testemunhe o desenrolar dos eventos históricos. Viva eventos importantes, desde a tomada da Bastilha à execução do Rei Luís XVI, conforme o destino da França é decidido nas ruas de uma cidade à beira da transformação.

EN NÅDESLØS NY HELT TIL EN BRUTAL NY VERDEN  
Spil som Arno: En helt ny type snigmorder, der er endnu mere dødbringende end hans forgængere. Nedlæg dit bytte med nye våben, som for eksempel dit Phantom Blade, der er en skjult klinge med armbrøstfunktionalitet.
        
  OPLEV FLYDENDE PARKOUR, KAMP OG SNIGEGAMEPLAY  
Oplev stor frihed og kontrol over din snigmorder med parkourmekanik, der lader dig løbe helt frit og flydende rundt, et nyt kampsystem og forbedret snigegameplay.
        
  UDFORSK REVOLUTIONENS PARIS  
Den franske revolution omdanner en engang så storslået by til et sted fyldt med rædsel og kaos. Udforsk den utroligt flotte åbne by, og se historien udfolde sig. Oplev vigtige historiske begivenheder, lige fra angrebet på Bastillen til henrettelsen af kong Louis den 16., mens Frankrigs skæbne afgøres i gaderne i en by, der er på randen af den totale transformation.

UN NUOVO EROE SPIETATO PER UN NUOVO MONDO BRUTALE  
Gioca nei panni di Arno, un Assassino totalmente diverso e molto più letale di chiunque l'abbia preceduto. Colpisci i tuoi nemici usando armi inedite come la lama fantasma, un incrocio fra lama celata e balestra.
        
  LA PERFETTA INTEGRAZIONE TRA CORSA ACROBATICA, COMBATTIMENTO E FURTIVITÀ  
Sfrutta al massimo la libertà di movimento e controllo del tuo Assassino, con meccaniche di corsa acrobatica senza soluzione di continuità, un sistema di combattimento rinnovato e sequenze furtive migliorate.
        
  SCOPRI LA PARIGI RIVOLUZIONARIA  
La Rivoluzione francese ha gettato nel terrore e nel caos quella che era una magnifica città. Esplora una magnifica città a mondo aperto, fedele in ogni dettaglio, e vivi la storia in prima persona. Assisti a momenti chiave, come la presa della Bastiglia e l'esecuzione di re Luigi XVI, mentre il futuro della Francia si decide sulle strade di una città sull'orlo del cambiamento.

game.brief:
A RUTHLESS NEW HERO FOR A BRUTAL NEW WORLD  
Play as Arno, an entirely new breed of Assassin more lethal than his ancestors. Take down your prey with a range of new weapons such as the Phantom Blade, a Hidden Blade with crossbow capabilities.
        
  EXPERIENCE SEAMLESS PARKOUR, COMBAT, AND STEALTH GAMEPLAY  
Enjoy a high degree of freedom and control over your Assassin, with parkour mechanics for seamless free running, a revamped fighting system, and enhanced stealth gameplay.
        
  DISCOVER REVOLUTIONARY PARIS  
The French Revolution turns a once magnificent city into a place of terror and chaos. Explore the stunning, full-scale open world city and witness history unfold. Experience key events, from the storming of the Bastille to the execution of King Louis XVI, as France's fate is shaped in the streets of a city on the edge of transformation.

game.title: Hitman: Absolution
game.description:
Hitman: Absolution follows the Original Assassin undertaking his most personal contract to date. Betrayed by the Agency and hunted by the police, Agent 47 finds himself pursuing redemption in a corrupt and twisted world. Key Features    Showcasing Glacier 2™ technology:  HITMAN: ABSOLUTION has been built from the ground up, boasting a cinematic story, distinctive art direction and highly original game and sound design.
    Freedom of Choice:  Stalk your prey, fight them head on or adapt as you go along. As Agent 47 the choice is yours thanks to highly evolved gameplay mechanics and a ground-breaking AI system.
    Experience a Living, Breathing World:  In the world of Hitman: Absolution every moment can become a story as unique characters, rich dialogue and Hollywood standard performances combine to create a gameplay experience like no other.
    Disguises:  As Agent 47, the identity of almost anyone you meet is yours for the taking. Immobilise your prey, steal their outfit and use your instinct to blend in and deceive your enemies.
    Instinct Mode:  See the world through the eyes of Agent 47 and become the world’s deadliest assassin. Using Hitman: Absolution’s Instinct Mode you’ll predict enemy movement, discover new ways to kill and use high powered weaponry with deadly accuracy.

HITMAN: ABSOLUTION sigue los pasos del asesino original mientras trabaja en su contrato más personal hasta la fecha. Traicionado por la Agencia y buscado por la policía, el Agente 47 se ve abocado a la búsqueda de la redención en un mundo corrupto y retorcido. Características Principales    Presentamos la tecnología Glacier 2™:  HITMAN: ABSOLUTION se ha construido a partir de cero para crear un título que hace gala de una historia cinematográfica, una destacable dirección artística y un diseño muy original del juego y el sonido
    Modo Contratos:  Crea tus propios desafíos personalizados escogiendo el nivel, los objetivos, las armas y las normas del asesinato en un nuevo e innovador modo online. Puedes compartir los contratos creados con tus amigos o con toda la comunidad de Hitman y el dinero que obtengas servirá para desbloquear armas, mejoras y disfraces
    Libertad de elección:  Acecha a tu presa; plántale cara directamente o adáptate a la situación. En el papel del Agente 47, la elección está en tus manos, gracias a la evolucionada mecánica de juego y a un revolucionario sistema de IA
    Sumérgete en un mundo vivo y vibrante:  En el mundo de Hitman: Absolution cualquier momento puede ser memorable; personajes peculiares, diálogos interesantes e interpretaciones de cine se combinan para crear una experiencia de juego sin igual
    Disfraces:  Como el Agente 47, la identidad de casi todos aquellos con los que te encuentres está a tu disposición. Inmoviliza a tu presa, róbale la ropa y usa tu instinto para camuflarte y engañar a tus enemigos
    Modo de Instinto:  Observa el mundo con los ojos del Agente 47 y conviértete en el asesino más letal del mundo. Usando el modo de instinto de Hitman: Absolution, predecirás los movimientos de los enemigos, descubrirás nuevas formas de matar y emplearás armamento de alta potencia con una precisión mortífera

Hitman: Absolution suit l'Agent 47 pendant l’exécution du contrat le plus personnel qu'il ait eu à ce jour. Trahi par l'Agence et traqué par la police, l'Agent 47 se retrouve au cœur d'un monde perverti et corrompu, à la recherche de la vérité et de la rédemption. Caractéristiques   Mettant en avant la technologie Glacier 2™ avec laquelle HITMAN: ABSOLUTION a été développé depuis le début, bénéficiant d'une histoire cinématographique, d'une direction artistique sans pareille et un design de jeu et sonore très original.
   Liberté de choix : traquez vos proies, combattez-les en tête à tête ou adaptez-vous au fur et à mesure. En tant qu'Agent 47, le choix vous appartient grâce à des mécaniques évoluées de gameplay et une IA à couper le souffle.
   Découvrez un monde vivant : dans le monde de Hitman: Absolution, n'importe quel instant peut devenir une histoire alors que chaque personnage unique, dialogues riches et performances hollywoodiennes s'unissent pour créer une expérience de jeu sans commune mesure.
   Déguisements : en tant qu'Agent 47, l'identité de presque tous ceux que vous rencontrez est à votre portée. Immobilisez votre proie, volez leur tenue et utilisez leur instinct pour vous fondre dans la masse et duper vos ennemis.
   Mode Instinct : voyez le monde aux travers des yeux de l'Agent 47 et devenez l'assassin le plus redoutable au monde. En utilisant le mode Instinct de Hitman: Absolution, vous prédirez les mouvements des ennemis, découvrirez de nouvelles façons de tuer et utiliserez de l'armement surpuissants à la précision mortelle.

HITMAN: ABSOLUTION erzählt die Geschichte von Agent 47, einem kaltblütigen Killer, der seinen bisher gefährlichsten Auftrag erhält. Verraten von jenen, denen er vertraut hat und von der Polizei gejagt, findet sich der „Original Assassin“ mitten im Zentrum einer dunklen Verschwörung wieder. Auf der Suche nach der Wahrheit begibt sich der Hitman auf seine ganz persönliche Jagd durch eine korrupte und verdorbene Welt. Hauptmerkmale    Herausragende Glacier 2™ Technologie:  HITMAN: ABSOLUTION basiert auf einer komplett neu entwickelten Engine, die filmreife Inszenierung und erstklassige Grafik und Musik zu einem beispiellosen Spielerlebnis verbindet. 
    Auftragsmodus:  Erstellen Sie Ihre eigenen Anschläge und wählen Sie Level, Ziele, Waffen und Regeln des Auftrags in einem innovativen, neuen Online-Modus. Aufträge können anderen Freunden und der gesamten Hitman Community mitgeteilt werden und das verdiente Geld kann zum Freischalten neuer Waffen, Upgrades und Verkleidungen verwendet werden.
    Entscheidungsfreiheit:  Raubtier, Rambo oder eiskalter Killer – Sie entscheiden. Täuschen Sie Ihre Opfer, bekämpfen Sie sie direkt oder agieren Sie unerkannt. In HITMAN: ABSOLUTION entscheiden Sie allein, wie Sie vorgehen wollen. 
    Realismus pur:  Durch die extrem detailgetreuen, realistischen Schauplätze und die lebensecht agierenden Charaktere, kombiniert mit einem leistungsstarken KI-System, ist jede Begegnung, jeder Dialog und jedes Ereignis in HITMAN: ABSOLUTION einzigartig. 
    Tarnung:  Als Agent 47 können Sie die Identität beinahe jedes Charakters annehmen. Machen Sie Ihr Opfer bewegungsunfähig, stehlen Sie sein Outfit und nutzen Sie es, um Ihre Gegner zu täuschen.
    Instinkt-Modus:  Sehen Sie die Welt durch die Augen des „Original Assassin“. Mit dem Instinkt-Modus von HITMAN: ABSOLUTION erfassen Sie Gegner, Ziele und Gegenstände, sehen gegnerische Bewegungen voraus und nutzen den verheerenden Zielschuss, um mehrere Gegner auf einmal zu erledigen.

HITMAN: ABSOLUTION segue l'assassino originale nella sua missione più personale. Tradito dall'Agenzia e ricercato dalla polizia, 47 cerca disperatamente la redenzione in un mondo malato e corrotto. Caratteristiche   HITMAN: ABSOLUTION è stato progettato da zero con la nuova tecnologia Glacier 2™, e offre una trama cinematografica, una direzione artistica unica, una giocabilità originale e uno stile sonoro fuori dal comune.
   Libertà di scelta: segui la tua preda, eliminala subito o cambia strategia passo dopo passo. Nei panni dell'agente 47, grazie a un sistema di gioco evoluto e alla rivoluzionaria intelligenza artificiale, la scelta è nelle tue mani.
   Scopri un mondo realistico e vibrante: nel mondo di Hitman: Absolution ogni momento racconta una storia, con personaggi unici, ricchi dialoghi e performance da Hollywood, per dare vita a un'esperienza di gioco senza paragoni.
   Travestimenti: nei panni di 47 puoi assumere l'identità di chiunque incontri. Immobilizza la preda, ruba i suoi abiti e usa l'istinto per mimetizzarti e ingannare i nemici.
   Modalità Istinto: vedi il mondo attraverso gli occhi di 47 e diventa l'assassino più letale del pianeta. Con la modalità Istinto di Hitman: Absolution potrai prevedere i movimenti nemici, scoprire nuovi modi di uccidere e usare armi potentissime con precisione mortale.

game.title: Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair
game.description:
Jabberwock Island – once a popular tourist destination, this now uninhabited island remains oddly pristine. You and your classmates at the elite Hope's Peak Academy have been brought to this island by your super-cute teacher for a “lovey-dovey, heart-throbbing school trip.” Everyone seems to be having fun in the sun...until Monokuma returns to restart his murderous game! Trapped on this island of mutual killing, your only hope of escape rests in solving the island’s mysteries. But be warned—sometimes the truth can be its own despair...
 
  Key Features 
    Deadly Island Vibes:  Murder is the only means of escape when you’re trapped on this island paradise. As your fellow classmates start dropping like coconuts, you’ll need to delve into each murderous incident, forage for clues, and interview your classmates to reveal the opportunity, motive, and means behind each killer case! 
 
  Tribal Council:  You’ll go head-to-head in all new minigames with the other students during the Class Trial, shooting down their false truths and using your evidence to uncover what really happened. But watch out! If a student is unconvinced, they'll challenge you to a one-on-one Rebuttal Showdown and force you to defend your argument! 
 
  Survival of the Keenest:  Match up your evidence with your fellow classmates’ arguments and determine who’s really telling the truth. Once you’ve got a suspect in your sights, turn up that tropical heat in a variety of timing and reflex-based game systems to reveal the ultimate truth and escape with your life!
 
  Steam Features:  Supports Steam Achievements and Steam Cloud with plans to add Steam Trading Cards

  Steam Features:  Supports Steam Achievements and Steam Cloud with plans to add Steam Trading Cards

Isla Jabberwock: una vez un popular destino turístico, esta isla ahora deshabitada sigue siendo extrañamente paradisíaca. Tú y tus compañeros de la élite de Hope's Peak Academy habéis sido traídos a esta isla por tu adorable profesor para un "viaje escolar lleno de amor y drama". Todo el mundo parece divertirse bajo el sol... ¡hasta que Monokuma regresa para reiniciar su juego asesino! Atrapado en esta isla de los asesinatos, tu única esperanza de escapar es resolver los misterios de la isla. Pero ten cuidado, a veces la verdad puede ser desesperada...
 

 
Características principales
 
Vibraciones mortales en la isla: asesinar es el único medio para escapar cuando estás atrapado en esta isla paradisíaca. Cuando tus compañeros de clase empiecen a caer como cocos, tendrás que ahondar en cada incidente de asesinato, buscar pistas y entrevistar a tus compañeros para revelar la oportunidad, el motivo y los medios detrás de cada caso.
 

 
Consejo tribal: en todos los minijuegos nuevos te enfrentarás a los otros estudiantes durante el juicio de clase, donde deberás desmontar sus mentiras y usar las pruebas para descubrir lo que realmente sucedió. ¡Pero ten cuidado! Si un estudiante no está convencido, te desafiará a un enfrentamiento de refutación y te obligará a defender tu argumento.
 

 
La supervivencia de los más astutos: compara tus pruebas con los argumentos de tus compañeros y determina quién dice realmente la verdad. Cuando tengas a un sospechoso en el punto de mira, haz que suba la temperatura tropical en una serie de sistemas de juego basados ​​en la coordinación y los reflejos para revelar la verdad suprema y huir con vida.
 

 
Funciones de Steam: admite logros de Steam y Steam Cloud, y está previsto añadir cromos de Steam.

L'île de Jabberwock – destination touristique prisée autrefois, cette île désormais déserte reste étrangement vierge. Vos camarades de classe de la Hope's Peak Academy et vous avez été amenés sur cette île par votre adorable institutrice pour une « excursion scolaire qui fera battre la chamade à vos petits cœurs ». Tout le monde semble s'amuser au soleil... jusqu'à ce que Monokuma fasse son retour pour relancer son jeu meurtrier ! Pris au piège sur cette île où il faut se tuer les uns les autres, votre seul espoir est de lever le voile sur les mystères de l'île. Mais soyez prévenu : la vérité est parfois source de désespoir...
 

 
Caractéristiques principales
 
Île mortelle : le meurtre est la seule échappatoire lorsque vous êtes pris au piège sur cette île paradisiaque. Tandis que vos camarades de classe se mettent à tomber comme des mouches, il vous faudra enquêter sur chaque incident meurtrier, creuser à la recherche d'indices et questionner vos camarades pour découvrir le mobile, l'opportunité et les moyens derrière chaque meurtre ! 
 

 
Conseil tribal : vous serez confronté aux autres élèves dans de tout nouveaux mini-jeux dans le cadre du procès de classe, afin de démonter leurs fausses vérités et d’user de vos preuves pour dévoiler ce qu'il s'est réellement passé. Mais attention ! Si un élève n'est pas convaincu, il vous défiera en face à face au Duel de réfutation et vous obligera à défendre votre argumentation ! 
 

 
Survie des plus motivés : confrontez vos preuves aux arguments de vos camarades de classe et déterminez qui dit vraiment la vérité. Une fois que vous aurez un suspect en ligne de mire, faites monter la température avec divers systèmes de jeu à base de timing et de réflexes pour découvrir la vérité et sauver votre peau !
 

 
Fonctionnalités Steam : prise en charge des succès Steam et du Steam Cloud, avec ajout prévu des cartes à échanger Steam.

Jabberwock Island war einst ein beliebtes Touristenziel. Diese nun unbewohnte Insel blieb aber seltsam unberührt. Du und deine Klassenkameraden an der Eliteschule Hope's Peak Academy wurden von eurer super netten Lehrerin zu einem „Turteltäubchen-Schulausflug“ auf die Insel gebracht. Alle scheinen das schöne Wetter zu genießen ... bis Monokuma zurückkehrt, um erneut sein mörderisches Spiel zu treiben! Gefangen auf dieser Insel des gegenseitigen Tötens, ist deine einzige Hoffnung auf Entkommen, die Geheimnisse der Insel zu lösen. Aber sei gewarnt – manchmal kann die Wahrheit den eigenen Untergang bedeuten...
 

 
Das erwartet dich:
 
Tödliche Insel-Atmosphäre: Mord ist der einzige Weg, um diesem Inselparadies zu entfliehen. Nachdem deine Klassenkameraden allmählich wie die Kokosnüsse gefällt werden, musst du dich intensiv mit jedem der Morde beschäftigen, nach Hinweisen suchen und zur Klärung von Gelegenheit, Mittel und Motiv jedes einzelnen Mordfalls deine Mitschüler befragen! 
 

 
Stammesrat: Du wirst während des Prozesses in der Klasse in ganz neuen Minispielen auf Konfrontationskurs mit anderen Schülern gehen und ihre falschen Behauptungen entlarven, um dem wahren Geschehen auf den Grund zu gehen. Aber sieh dich vor! Sollte ein Schüler Zweifel haben, wird er dich zu einem direkten Gegenbeweis-Duell herausfordern und dich dazu zwingen, deine Sichtweise zu verteidigen! 
 

 
Überleben der Scharfsinnigsten: Gleiche deine Indizien mit den Argumenten deiner Klassenkameraden ab und stelle fest, wer wirklich die Wahrheit sagt. Sobald du einen Verdächtigen im Blick hast, solltest du kräftig Gas geben und mithilfe von zeit- und reflexbasierten Spielsystemen die volle Wahrheit aufdecken und damit dein Leben retten!
 

 
Steam-Funktionen: Unterstützt Steam-Errungenschaften und Steam Cloud. Steam-Sammelkarten sind geplant.

A Jabberwock Island já foi um destino turístico popular, mas agora é uma ilha inabitada que permanece estranhamente imaculada. Você e seus colegas da Hope's Peak Academy foram trazidos a esta ilha para uma "viagem escolar apaixonante de acelerar o coração". Todos parecem estar se divertindo... até que Monokuma retorna com o seu jogo assassino! Preso nesta ilha da morte, sua única esperança para escapar é resolver os mistérios da ilha. Mas não esqueça: às vezes a verdade pode ser o próprio desespero...

Características principais
Ilha Fatal: Assassinato é a única escapatória desta ilha paradisíaca. Conforme seus colegas começam a cair como cocos maduros, você precisará examinar cada incidente, buscar pistas e entrevistar outros colegas de classe para revelar a oportunidade, o motivo e o método por trás de cada assassinato!

Conselho Tribal: Você competirá de igual para igual com os outros estudantes em novos minijogos durante o Julgamento da Classe, refutando as verdades falsas e usando suas evidências para revelar o que realmente aconteceu. Mas cuidado! Se um estudante não for convencido, ele te desafiará para um Confronto de Refutação cara a cara e te forçará a defender o seu argumento!

Sobrevivência do Mais Forte: Compare suas evidências com os argumentos dos seus colegas e determine quem realmente está dizendo a verdade. Quando um suspeito estiver na sua mira, aumente o calor tropical com uma variedade de sistemas de jogo de reflexo e sincronia para revelar a verdade derradeira e escapar com vida!

Jabberwock Island – once a popular tourist destination, this now uninhabited island remains oddly pristine. You and your classmates at the elite Hope's Peak Academy have been brought to this island by your super-cute teacher for a “lovey-dovey, heart-throbbing school trip.” Everyone seems to be having fun in the sun...until Monokuma returns to restart his murderous game! Trapped on this island of mutual killing, your only hope of escape rests in solving the island’s mysteries. But be warned—sometimes the truth can be its own despair...
 
  Key Features 
    Deadly Island Vibes:  Murder is the only means of escape when you’re trapped on this island paradise. As your fellow classmates start dropping like coconuts, you’ll need to delve into each murderous incident, forage for clues, and interview your classmates to reveal the opportunity, motive, and means behind each killer case! 
 
  Tribal Council:  You’ll go head-to-head in all new minigames with the other students during the Class Trial, shooting down their false truths and using your evidence to uncover what really happened. But watch out! If a student is unconvinced, they'll challenge you to a one-on-one Rebuttal Showdown and force you to defend your argument! 
 
  Survival of the Keenest:  Match up your evidence with your fellow classmates’ arguments and determine who’s really telling the truth. Once you’ve got a suspect in your sights, turn up that tropical heat in a variety of timing and reflex-based game systems to reveal the ultimate truth and escape with your life!
 
  Steam Features:  Supports Steam Achievements and Steam Cloud with plans to add Steam Trading Cards

Jabberwock Island: Una volta popolare meta turistica, ora è un'isola disabitata stranamente immacolata. Tu e i tuoi compagni di classe dell'elitaria accademia Hope's Peak siete stati portati su quest'isola per una "deliziosa gitarella scolastica che fa battere i cuoricini" dall'adorabilie insegnante. Tutti sembrano divertirsi sotto il sole... finché Monokuma torna per ricominciare il suo gioco mortale! Intrappolati sull'isola per uccidervi a vicenda, l'unica speranza di fuggire sta nel risolvere i misteri dell'isola. Ma attenzione: a volte la verità può essere scomoda...
 

 
Caratteristiche
 
Vibrazioni mortali sull'isola: omicidio è l'unico modo per fuggire quando sei intrappolato in questa isola paradisiaca. Mentre i tuoi compagni di classe cominciano a cadere come noci di cocco, dovrai andare a fondo in ogni misterioso incidente a caccia di indizi e interrogare i tuoi compagni di classe per scoprire opportunità, movente e mezzi dietro ogni caso di omicidio!
 

 
Consiglio tribale: Affronterai faccia a faccia gli altri studenti con minigiochi tutti nuovi durante i processi di classe, sbattendogli in faccia le loro false verità e usando le tue prove per svelare quel che è successo davvero. Ma attenzione! Se uno studente non è convinto ti sfiderà personalmente in un faccia a faccia obbligandoti a difendere le tue argomentazioni!
 

 
Sopravvivenza del più sveglio: Combina le tue prove con le affermazioni dei tuoi compagni e stabilisci chi sta dicendo la verità. Una volta che hai un sospettato in vista, mettilo sotto torchio in numerosi giochi basati sul tempismo e sui riflessi per rivelare la verità definitiva e uscirne vivo!
 

 
Caratteristiche Steam: Supporto per gli achievement di Steam, Steam Cloud e Carte collezionabili Steam.

The follow up to Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc. The main character, Hajime Hinata, a new 'Ultimate' student at Hope's Peak Academy. On their first day, Hajime and all of his classmates are taken on a field trip to the mysterious Jabberwock island by their anthropomorphic rabbit teacher, Usami. Usami explains that on this island the students are to have fun together and become friends to gather Hope Fragments. Usami's field trip does not go as planned when Monokuma appears and begins a new Killing Game. Anyone that wants to leave the island must commit a murder and get away with it. If the murderer is successful, he/she is allowed to leave the island, while everyone else is killed. When a murder occurs, the player investigates. After the investigations, a trial commences to determine who the culprit is.

リゾート地として有名な南の島・ジャバウォック島に修学旅行で訪れた希望ヶ峰学園の生徒達だったが、学園長の悪だくみによって島に閉じ込められてしまう。
島の脱出を条件に、生徒達はコロシアイ、そして犯人を探し出す学級裁判を強いられる。
ハイスピードでテンポよく展開する学級裁判は捜査パートで集めた証言や証拠を弾丸としてトリガーにセットし、相手の主張の矛盾を打ち抜くことで進行していく。
渦巻く疑心。見えない狂気。極限状態のなか、進化した学級裁判が始まる。

game.title: Resident Evil 4
game.description:
Resident Evil 4 is a remake of the 2005 original Resident Evil 4 reimagined for 2023 to bring state-of-the-art survival horror. Resident Evil 4 preserves the essence of the original game, while introducing modernized gameplay, a reimagined storyline,
and vividly detailed graphics to make this the latest survival horror game where life and death, terror and catharsis intersect.

Set six years after the events of Resident Evil 2, an older and significantly toughened Leon S. Kennedy has been shaped by his experiences of enduring the disaster that wiped Raccoon City off the map and events beyond. Now reporting directly to the President of the United States of America, Leon is given a new assignment: To locate and rescue the President’s kidnapped daughter. Tracking her location to a secluded village in the European countryside, Leon prepares to take his first steps into another nightmare that reaches far past reason.

localized_description.text:
Resident Evil 4 is a remake of the 2005 original Resident Evil 4 reimagined for 2023 to bring state-of-the-art survival horror. Resident Evil 4 preserves the essence of the original game, while introducing modernized gameplay, a reimagined storyline,
and vividly detailed graphics to make this the latest survival horror game where life and death, terror and catharsis intersect.

Set six years after the events of Resident Evil 2, an older and significantly toughened Leon S. Kennedy has been shaped by his experiences of enduring the disaster that wiped Raccoon City off the map and events beyond. Now reporting directly to the President of the United States of America, Leon is given a new assignment: To locate and rescue the President’s kidnapped daughter. Tracking her location to a secluded village in the European countryside, Leon prepares to take his first steps into another nightmare that reaches far past reason.

Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition     
 
 Notes:
 - Items contained in this set can be purchased individually. Please take care to avoid duplicate purchases.
 - Please update Resident Evil 4 to the latest patch before playing Separate Ways or using the Extra DLC Pack.
 
 Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition includes Resident Evil 4 and two additional items of content: Separate Ways, where you experience the story through Ada Wong's perspective, and the Extra DLC Pack, which contains additional character outfits as well as useful weapons and items.
 
 Resident Evil 4:
 6 years have passed since the biological disaster in Raccoon City. Leon S. Kennedy tracks the president's missing daughter to a secluded European village, where there is something terribly wrong with the villagers.
 
 Featuring modernized gameplay, a reimagined storyline, and vividly detailed graphics, Resident Evil 4 marks the rebirth of an industry juggernaut. Relive the nightmare that revolutionized survival horror.
 
 Separate Ways:
 Play as Ada Wong in this additional scenario, filling in unanswered questions posed in the main story. With her mission to retrieve the Amber looming over her, which path will she choose?
 
 Extra DLC Pack:
 - Leon & Ashley Costumes: 'Casual'
 - Leon & Ashley Costumes: 'Romantic'
 - Leon Costume & Filter: 'Hero'
 - Leon Costume & Filter: 'Villain'
 - Leon Accessory: 'Sunglasses (Sporty)'

  About the Game Survival is just the beginning.
 
 Six years have passed since the biological disaster in Raccoon City.
 Agent Leon S. Kennedy, one of the survivors of the incident, has been sent to rescue the president's kidnapped daughter.
 He tracks her to a secluded European village, where there is something terribly wrong with the locals.
 And the curtain rises on this story of daring rescue and grueling horror where life and death, terror and catharsis intersect.
 
 Featuring modernized gameplay, a reimagined storyline, and vividly detailed graphics,
 Resident Evil 4 marks the rebirth of an industry juggernaut.
 
 Relive the nightmare that revolutionized survival horror.

Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition     
 
 Notas:
 - Los artículos incluidos en este set pueden adquirirse individualmente. Ten cuidado para evitar compras duplicadas.
 - Antes de jugar a Caminos distintos o de usar el pack de DLC extra, actualiza Resident Evil 4 al parche más reciente.
 
 Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition incluye Resident Evil 4 y dos contenidos adicionales: Caminos distintos, donde vivirás los acontecimientos desde el punto de vista de Ada Wong, y el pack de DLC extra, que incluye trajes de personajes adicionales, así como armas y otros artículos útiles.
 
 Resident Evil 4:
 Han transcurrido seis años desde el desastre biológico de Raccoon City. Leon S. Kennedy sigue el rastro de la hija desaparecida del presidente de los EE. UU. hasta una remota aldea europea, donde un mal terrible afecta a sus habitantes.
 
 Con mecánicas de juego modernizadas, una historia renovada y unos gráficos espectacularmente detallados, Resident Evil 4 marca la resurrección de un gigante del sector. Revive la pesadilla que revolucionó el género del «survival horror».
 
 Caminos distintos
 Juega como Ada Wong en esta trama adicional para descubrir respuestas a incógnitas que la historia principal dejó sin responder. ¿Qué decisiones tomará para cumplir su misión de recuperar el Ambar?
 
 Pack de DLC extra:
 - Trajes de Leon y Ashley: «Alternativos»
 - Trajes de Leon y Ashley: «Románticos»
 - Traje de Leon y filtro: «Héroe»
 - Traje de Leon y filtro: «Villano»
 - Accesorio de Leon: «Gafas de sol (deportivas)»
 - Arma deluxe: «Sentinel Nine»
 - Arma deluxe: «Skull Shaker»
 - Banda sonora clásica

  Acerca del juego Sobrevivir es solo el principio.
 
 Seis años después de la catástrofe biológica en Raccoon City, el agente Leon S. Kennedy, uno de los supervivientes del desastre, ha sido enviado a rescatar a la hija del presidente, a quien han secuestrado. Siguiendo su rastro, llega a una apartada población europea, donde sus habitantes sufren un mal terrible. Así comienza esta historia de un arriesgado rescate y terror escalofriante donde se cruzan la vida y la muerte, y el miedo y la catarsis.
 
 Con una mecánica de juego modernizada, una historia reimaginada y unos gráficos espectacularmente detallados, Resident Evil 4 supone el renacimiento de un gigante del mundo de los videojuegos.
 
 Revive la pesadilla que revolucionó el género del survival horror.

Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition     
 
 Remarques :
 - Les articles inclus dans ce pack peuvent être achetés à l'unité. Assurez-vous d'éviter tout achat en double.
 - Veuillez vous assurer aussi que Resident Evil 4 dispose de la dernière mise à jour avant de jouer à Une autre voie ou d'utiliser le pack Extra DLC.
 
 Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition inclut Resident Evil 4 et deux contenus supplémentaires : Une autre voie, qui vous permet de découvrir l'histoire au travers des yeux d'Ada Wong, et le pack Extra DLC, qui contient des tenues additionnelles, ainsi que des armes et des objets utiles.
 
 Resident Evil 4 :
 Six années se sont écoulées depuis le désastre biologique de Raccoon City. Sur les traces de la fille disparue du président, Leon S. Kennedy arrive dans un village européen isolé, où sévit un mal effroyable.
 
 Avec un gameplay modernisé, une histoire réécrite et des graphismes superbement détaillés, Resident Evil 4 signe la renaissance d'un monstre de l'industrie. Replongez dans le cauchemar qui a révolutionné les jeux d'horreur et de survie.
 
 Une autre voie :
 Incarnez Ada Wong dans ce scénario supplémentaire qui répond à certaines des interrogations restées en plan de l'histoire principale. En quête de l'Ambre, comment la jeune femme va-t-elle s'y prendre ?
 
 Extra DLC Pack :
 - Tenues pour Leon et Ashley : "Alternatif"
 - Tenues pour Leon et Ashley : "Romantique"
 - Tenue pour Leon et filtre : "Héros"
 - Tenue pour Leon et filtre : "Vilain"
 - Accessoire pour Leon : "Lunettes de soleil sportives"
 - Arme spéciale : "Sentinel Nine"
 - Arme spéciale : "Skull Shaker"
 - Bande-son classique
 - Carte aux trésors : Extension
 
  À propos du jeu La survie n'est que le début.
 
 Six ans se sont écoulés depuis la catastrophe biologique de Raccoon City. L'agent Leon S. Kennedy, l'un des survivants du drame, est envoyé secourir la fille du président qui a été kidnappée. Son enquête le mène jusqu'à un village européen isolé, dont les habitants cachent un effroyable secret. Et ainsi se lève le rideau d'une histoire de sauvetage audacieux et d'horreur atroce, où se mêlent vie, mort, terreur et catharsis.
 
 Avec un gameplay modernisé, une histoire revisitée et des graphismes ultra détaillés, Resident Evil 4 signe la renaissance d'un monstre de l'industrie.
 
 Replongez dans le cauchemar qui a révolutionné les jeux d'horreur et de survie.

Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition     
 
 Hinweise:
 – Die in diesem Set enthaltenen Gegenstände können einzeln gekauft werden. Bitte achte darauf, doppelte Käufe zu vermeiden.
 – Bitte aktualisiere Resident Evil 4 auf den neuesten Patch, bevor du Separate Ways spielst oder das Extra-DLC-Paket nutzt.
 
 Die Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition enthält Resident Evil 4 und zwei zusätzliche Inhalte: Separate Ways, wo du die Story aus Sicht von Ada Wong erlebst, und das Extra-DLC-Paket, das zusätzliche Charakter-Outfits sowie nützliche Waffen und Gegenstände enthält.
 
 Resident Evil 4:
 6 Jahre sind seit der biologischen Katastrophe in Raccoon City vergangen. Die Suche nach der vermissten Tochter des Präsidenten führt Leon S. Kennedy in ein abgelegenes europäisches Dorf, in dem etwas Schreckliches mit den Dorfbewohnern passiert ist.
 
 Mit modernisiertem Gameplay, einer neu gestalteten Story und detaillierter Grafik markiert Resident Evil 4 die Wiedergeburt eines Branchenvorreiters. Erlebe den Albtraum, der eine Revolution des Survival-Horror-Genres ausgelöst hat.
 
 Separate Ways:
 In diesem Extra-Szenario schlüpfst du in die Rolle von Ada Wong, um Antworten auf die unbeantworteten Fragen aus der Haupt-Story zu finden. Welchen Pfad wird sie bei der Suche nach dem Bernstein einschlagen?

  Infos zum Spiel Das Überleben ist erst der Anfang.
 
 Sechs Jahre sind seit der biologischen Katastrophe in Raccoon City vergangen. Agent Leon S. Kennedy, einer der Überlebenden des Vorfalls, wurde mit der Rettung der entführten Tochter des Präsidenten betraut. Er verfolgte ihre Spur in ein entlegendes europäisches Dorf, in dem mit den Einheimischen etwas ganz und gar nicht zu stimmen scheint ... Nun hebt sich der Vorhang und es beginnt eine Geschichte einer wagemutigen Rettung und des grausamen Horrors, in der Leben und Tod, Schrecken und Katharsis zusammenlaufen.
 
 Mit an Bord sind ein modernisiertes Gameplay, eine neu entwickelte Storyline und lebhaft detaillierte Grafik. Resident Evil 4 markiert die Wiedergeburt eines echten Schwergewichts der Industrie.
 
 Erlebe den Albtraum, der das Genre des Survival-Horrors revolutionierte, noch einmal aufs Neue.

Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition     
 
 Notas:
 - Os itens deste conjunto podem ser comprados individualmente. Evita fazer compras em duplicado.
 - Atualiza o Resident Evil 4 para o patch mais recente antes de jogares Separate Ways ou de usares o Pacote de DLC Adicional.

 Resident Evil 4:
 passaram 6 anos desde o desastre biológico em Raccoon City. Leon S. Kennedy procura a filha do presidente numa aldeia isolada na Europa, onde algo de terrivelmente errado se passa com os habitantes.
 
 Com uma jogabilidade modernizada, um enredo reinventado e gráficos superdetalhados, Resident Evil 4 assinala o renascimento de um gigante da indústria. Revive o pesadelo que revolucionou o género do horror de sobrevivência.
 
 Separate Ways:
 joga no papel de Ada Wong neste cenário adicional, revelando perguntas deixadas por responder na história principal. Com o peso da missão de recuperar o Amber nos seus ombros, que caminho vai escolher?

  Acerca do jogo A sobrevivência é apenas o início.
 
 Passaram seis anos desde o desastre biológico de Raccoon City. O agente Leon S. Kennedy, um dos poucos sobreviventes do incidente, foi enviado para salvar a filha raptada do presidente. Leon consegue encontrá-la numa aldeia isolada na Europa, onde algo terrível terá acontecido aos seus habitantes. Assim sobe a cortina desta história de salvamento e terror, onde a vida e a morte, o terror e a catarse, se encontram.
 
 Com jogabilidade melhorada, uma história reimaginada e grafismos detalhados, Resident Evil 4 é o renascer de um clássico.
 
 Volta a viver o pesadelo que revolucionou os jogos de terror e sobrevivência.

Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition     
 
 Bemærkninger:

 - Opdatér Resident Evil 4 til den nyeste patch, før du spiller Separate Ways eller bruger Extra DLC Pack.
 
 Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition indeholder Resident Evil 4 og to ekstra ting: Separate Ways, hvor du oplever historien fra Ada Wongs perspektiv, og Extra DLC Pack, der indeholder flere kostumer og nyttige våben og genstande.
 
 Resident Evil 4:
 Der er gået seks år siden den biologiske katastrofe i Raccoon City. Leon S. Kennedy sporer præsidentens forsvundne datter til en afsidesliggende, europæisk landsby, hvor der er noget frygteligt galt med indbyggerne.
 
 Spilsystemerne er moderniseret, historien er genfortalt og grafikken er utroligt detaljeret, så Resident Evil 4 markerer branchegigantens genfødsel. Genoplev mareridtet, der revolutionerede overlevelsesgyset.
 
 Separate Ways:
 I dette ekstrascenarie spiller du Ada Wong, så du kan få svar på mange ubesvarede spørgsmål fra hovedspillet. Adas mission er at genfinde den forsvundne Amber-prøve, men hvilken vej vælger hun til målet?

  Om spillet Overlevelse er kun begyndelsen.
 
 Der er gået seks år siden den biologiske katastrofe i Raccoon City. Agent Leon S. Kennedy, en af de overlevende fra hændelsen, er blevet sendt ud for at redde præsidentens kidnappede datter. Han sporer hende til en afsidesliggende, europæisk landsby, hvor der er noget frygteligt galt med de lokale. Her går tæppet for en historie om dristig redning og gruelig rædsel, hvor liv og død, skræk og katarsis mødes.
 
 Med moderniserede spilsystemer, en gentænkt historie og livligt detaljeret grafik markerer Resident Evil 4 en af branchens titaners genfødsel.
 
 Genoplev det mareridt, der revolutionerede overlevelsesgyset.

Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition     
 
 Note:
 - Gli elementi contenuti in questo set possono essere acquistati individualmente. Fa' attenzione a non acquistare due volte lo stesso contenuto.

 Resident Evil 4:
 Sono passati sei anni dal disastro biologico di Raccoon City. Leon S. Kennedy rintraccia la figlia scomparsa del presidente in un sperduto villaggio europeo i cui abitanti sono vittime di un tremendo male.
 
 Grazie a un gameplay modernizzato, una storia rinnovata e una grafica viva e dettagliata, Resident Evil 4 segna la rinascita di un colosso dell'industria. Rivivi l'incubo che ha rivoluzionato il genere survival horror.
 
 Strade diverse:
 Vesti i panni di Ada Wong in questo scenario aggiuntivo, rispondendo a tutti gli interrogativi rimasti irrisolti nella storia principale. La sua missione di recuperare l'ambra incombe, ma quale via sceglierà?

  Informazioni sul gioco Sopravvivere è solo l'inizio.
 
 Sono passati sei anni dalla catastrofe biologica di Raccoon City. L'agente Leon S. Kennedy, uno dei sopravvissuti all'incidente, è stato inviato a salvare la figlia rapita del presidente. La individua in un villaggio europeo sperduto, dove gli abitanti hanno decisamente qualcosa che non va, e il sipario si alza su una storia di salvataggi spericolati e orrori indicibili, in un intreccio di vita e morte, terrore e catarsi.
 
 Con un'esperienza di gioco modernizzata, una trama reinventata e grafica ricca di dettagli vividi, Resident Evil 4 segna la rinascita di un colosso del settore.
 
 Rivivi l'incubo che ha rivoluzionato il survival horror.

Resident Evil 4 is a remake of the 2005 original Resident Evil 4 reimagined for 2023 to bring state-of-the-art survival horror. Resident Evil 4 preserves the essence of the original game, while introducing modernized gameplay, a reimagined storyline,
and vividly detailed graphics to make this the latest survival horror game where life and death, terror and catharsis intersect.

Set six years after the events of Resident Evil 2, an older and significantly toughened Leon S. Kennedy has been shaped by his experiences of enduring the disaster that wiped Raccoon City off the map and events beyond. Now reporting directly to the President of the United States of America, Leon is given a new assignment: To locate and rescue the President’s kidnapped daughter. Tracking her location to a secluded village in the European countryside, Leon prepares to take his first steps into another nightmare that reaches far past reason.

游玩《双人成行》，踏上生命中最疯狂的旅程，这是一款别开生面的平台冒险游戏，完全为合作模式而设计。利用好友通行证邀请一位好友免费游玩，共同体验多种多样的乐趣，享受颠覆性的玩法挑战。扮演相互看不顺眼的科迪和小梅夫妇，这两个人被魔咒变成了玩偶。他们一起被困在一个奇幻世界里，每个角落都隐藏着意想不到的东西，他们不得不一起克服挑战，同时挽救他们破裂的关系。

在每个新关卡中，掌握角色独特且与对方息息相关的能力。一定要互相帮助，克服大量出乎意料的障碍，共度搞笑欢乐的时刻。用力踢流氓松鼠毛茸茸的尾巴，绕过一条内裤，在热闹的夜店里开舞会，坐雪橇穿过神奇的雪花玻璃球。一个真挚又搞笑的故事在游戏中徐徐展开，交织成独特的隐喻体验。

《双人成行》由业界合作游戏领导者且屡获殊荣的工作室 Hazelight 开发。他们即将带您踏上狂野而奇妙的旅程，只有一件事是确定的：二人同心，其利断金。

主要特色：
纯粹而完美的合作模式——通过远程同乐**邀请好友免费畅玩，体验一场纯粹为两位玩家打造的惊奇冒险。体验分屏显示模式，选择本地合作或在线联机，面对不断变化的挑战，团结一致是前进的唯一途径。
搞笑又颠覆想像的游戏——从暴走的真空吸尘器到走心的爱情大师，您永远不会知道接下来会遇到什么。每个关卡都有大量别开生面的挑战和需要掌握的全新角色技能，体验故事和游戏交织的隐喻风格，推动互动式故事徐徐展开。
关于人际关系的故事——在克服挑战的相处中发现真挚情感。帮助科迪和小梅学习如何克服他们之间的分歧。结识各种奇特和可爱的角色。团结一致，一起踏上冒险之旅！

关于 HAZELIGHT
Hazelight 位于瑞典斯德哥尔摩，是一家屡获殊荣的独立游戏开发工作室。在 2014 年由 Josef Fares（影片导演和获奖游戏《兄弟：双子传说》的创作者）创办，Hazelight 致力于推动游戏的创意界限。在 2018 年，Hazelight 发布了荣获 BAFTA 奖的游戏《A Way Out》——史上第一款第三人称动作-冒险合作游戏——这是 EA Originals 计划的一部分。

关于 EA ORIGINALS
EA Originals 帮助全球充满热情,自成一格,才华横溢的游戏工作室崭露头角。发掘别出心裁的游戏制作者，探索他们天马行空的想象力，展现新颖而难忘的游戏体验。
EA paly线上活动公布了《逃出生天》工作室hazelight的最新游戏《It Takes Two》，游戏总监Josef Fares曾表示本作会让玩家感到“被干翻（Get Fucked）”。本作将于2021年发售，预计没有中文
